title: UGC-style shots
summary: Phone-camera style shots: selfie talk, get ready with me, your own demo, problem and fix, unboxing. Your own voice or a creator you hire who says it is a paid partnership.
rules: UGC-style means the look, not a fake customer. Every shot is the member's own demo or a creator they hire who discloses the paid partnership. Never script a customer review or a testimonial.
